# The Host Report

> The Host Report is the STR industry's go-to knowledge platform for Airbnb hosts and property managers seeking optimization tools, market intelligence, and operational strategies.

The Host Report combines a comprehensive resource library with the Booking Booster app to help short-term rental operators maximize revenue and efficiency. The platform covers everything from pricing strategy and listing optimization to property management automation and industry news.

## Key Topics

- Airbnb hosts
- Short-term rental (STR) management
- Property management systems (PMS)
- Booking optimization
- Listing optimization
- Pricing strategy
- AI tools
- Smart locks
- Host tools and templates
- Vacation rental industry news
- Direct booking strategy
- OTA fees
- Travel trends
- Guest experience
- Revenue management

## Core Platform & Tools

- [The Host Report](https://www.thehostreport.com): Homepage for The Host Report, STR industry knowledge platform
- [Booking Booster Tools for Airbnb Hosts](https://app.thehostreport.com): Booking Booster app with custom maps and listing optimization tools
- [Hero Image Optimization Tool](https://app.thehostreport.com/heroimage): AI-powered hero image optimization tool with effects for Airbnb listings
- [Free Tools & Templates for Airbnb Hosts](https://www.thehostreport.com/resources): Free Airbnb host tools, templates, and calculators for operations

- [Airbnb's 2025 Summer Release: What Hosts Need to Know](https://www.thehostreport.com/news/airbnbs-2025-summer-release-what-hosts-need-to-know): Airbnb 2025 summer release with app redesign and new services
- [2026 Travel Trends: Property Managers Focus on Efficiency While Travelers Seek Experiences](https://www.thehostreport.com/news/2026-travel-trends-property-managers-focus-on-efficiency-while-travelers-seek-experiences): 2026 travel trends and guest expectations for vacation rentals
- [Repeat Guests Are Costing STR Operators Millions in OTA Fees](https://www.thehostreport.com/news/repeat-guests-are-costing-str-operators-millions-in-ota-fees): Direct booking strategy to reduce OTA fees from repeat guests
